race.comment: WONDERDOWNUNDER (5) is back from a spell of four months having built nicely to a maiden win in his first campaign, going to the paddock off a solid victory at Mornington. Had a couple of jumpouts and Shinn goes on, he can pick up where he left off. TAUTO BAR (14) was too good for a maiden field last start over 1200m at Moe, scoring by 4 lengths. Didn't beat much there but loved the conditions and can go right on with it. DIAMOND EYE (13) recorded her first win last start over 1300m at Bendigo, getting home by a neck. Very tough draw but respecting if they're coming wide in the straight. VALEDICTORIAN (10) has been in the market at his last couple of starts since resuming but hasn't made an impression, last start running sixth at this track. Expect a bold showing.
